observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the left margin and the locator «p. 225.» (L19) in the right margin; in the locator the 2s are printed blotted. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of F: 5 stands beside the first line of the title, 10 beside its fifth line.

body L1-L8: the head F is set in a larger bold type and centred; the title is set in a larger type as a paragraph whose second and following lines are indented; «(1)» in it is in the type of the text.

body L16, L21-L22: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXII) read «149,21 et 26–27, emendandae sicut p. 326 exposui.»; lines 21 and 26-27 of the print are L16 and L21-L22 here; they are kept as printed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
